milestones.name: Defeat Anra / Dr. Halyn
milestones.note: Two-phase fight; phase one vs Anra (mobile/aggressive), phase two vs Dr. Halyn's mechanical arm holding Anra's corpse

milestones.name: Defeat Friends
milestones.note: Requires Friendly Invitation key; fought while climbing a wall

milestones.name: Defeat Lombre – Intrusive Fertiliser
milestones.note: Requires Dodge ability; poison enters arena mid-fight

milestones.name: Defeat Vlad
milestones.note: Endurance fight; Vlad never attacks directly

milestones.name: Defeat Ancile Targa
milestones.note: Two Egis-type enemies; requires defeating Friends first to access via lift room hole

milestones.name: Defeat Debby
milestones.note: Activate all water pumps in the Vaults to unlock boss door; disappearing floor mechanics

milestones.name: Defeat Poltergates – Dr. Halyn's Experiment #233
milestones.note: Visually stunning, mechanically demanding; combines several earlier fight mechanics

zones.name: Anra / Dr. Halyn Boss Area
zones.note: Story progression location; two-phase boss arena

zones.name: Friends Boss Area
zones.note: Requires Friendly Invitation key to access; wall-climbing combat environment

zones.name: Lower Area
zones.note: Accessed by descending; leads to Lombre boss via the only path

zones.name: Lombre Boss Arena
zones.note: Poison enters arena mid-fight; burrowing enemy encounter

zones.name: Vlad Boss Area
zones.note: Circular arena with spinning walls, spikes, and electrical current phases

zones.name: Lift Room
zones.note: Contains a hole connecting right and left map sides; used to reach Ancile Targa

zones.name: Ancile Targa Boss Area
zones.note: Requires defeating Friends first and passing through lift room hole

zones.name: The Vaults
zones.note: Contains water pumps that must all be activated to open Debby's boss door

zones.name: Debby Boss Area
zones.note: Platform-destruction arena; accessed after activating all water pumps in the Vaults

zones.name: Poltergates Boss Area
zones.fingerprintHint: Under the stairs, lowest area, enter the left door
zones.note: Mechanically demanding; combines mechanics from earlier fights

abilities.name: Dodge
abilities.note: Required mastery for Lombre fight; also useful against Friends and Sawlong

abilities.name: Friendly Invitation
abilities.note: Key item required to reach the Friends boss

abilities.name: Double Jump
abilities.note: Used during Debby fight to cross large gaps created by destroyed platforms

bosses.name: Anra
bosses.note: Phase one of two-phase fight; mobile and aggressive, uses projectiles and a shield (yellow orb in mechanical hand)

bosses.name: Dr. Halyn
bosses.note: Phase two; mechanical arm performs ground pounds while holding Anra's corpse

bosses.name: Friends
bosses.note: Slimy blob boss; gooey tentacles spread across screen, fought while climbing a wall

bosses.name: Lombre – Intrusive Fertiliser
bosses.note: Burrows and surfaces; poison rain leaves only one safe gap mid-fight; requires Dodge

bosses.name: Vlad
bosses.note: Never attacks directly; circular arena with spikes, projectiles, spinning walls, and electrical currents

bosses.name: Ancile Targa
bosses.note: Two Egis-type enemies that move in unison; dash attacks; punish recovery windows

bosses.name: Debby
bosses.note: Drops explosives destroying platforms; rapid-fire attack from screen edge

bosses.name: Poltergates – Dr. Halyn's Experiment #233
bosses.note: Difficulty ★★★★☆; visually stunning, combines several earlier fight mechanics
